title: O Primeiro Convite
summary: Adrian and Luk return to Los Angeles, Kairos reviews Owen's candidacy, and Cameron Ruiz, known as Mold, enters the scouting record.
keyEvents: Adrian and Luk return to the Kairos campus after meeting Owen and Arthur in Mackenzie.
Kairos reviews Owen's candidacy after extending the evaluation invitation in Episode 37.
Cameron Ruiz and the nickname Mold make their first canonical appearance.
No invitation is issued to Cameron.
Cameron is 18, lives in Truth or Consequences, New Mexico, works part-time as a mechanic, and plays Entry.
consequences: Owen remains invited to a non-binding three-week evaluation.
Cameron remains an unsigned scouted prospect.
